result.markdown: --- title: "[vals.fmt_duration()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Format values as time duration strings. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/great-tables/blob/main/great_tables/_formats_vals.py#L1302-L1387){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python vals.fmt_duration( x, input_units=None, output_units=None, duration_style="narrow", trim_zero_units=True, max_output_units=None, pattern="{x}", use_seps=True, sep_mark=",", force_sign=False, locale=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} With numeric values in a list, we can transform those to values of time duration with various human readable styles. The `val_fmt_duration()` function allows for formatting of duration values to narrow, wide, colon-separated, and ISO 8601 forms. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [x]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [X]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A list of numeric values to be formatted as durations. [input_units]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The time units of the input numeric values. Required for numeric input. The accepted units are: `"seconds"`, `"minutes"`, `"hours"`, `"days"`, and `"weeks"`. [output_units]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | list[str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Controls the output time units. The default (`None`) means that output units will be automatically chosen. Can be a list of keywords from: `"weeks"`, `"days"`, `"hours"`, `"minutes"`, or `"seconds"`. [duration_style]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["narrow"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Style for representing duration values. One of `"narrow"` (default, e.g., `"1d 8h 24m"`), `"wide"` (e.g., `"1 day 8 hours 24 minutes"`), `"colon-sep"` (e.g., `"1/08:24:00"`), or `"iso"` (e.g., `"P1DT8H24M"`). [trim_zero_units]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool | list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Provides methods to remove output time units that have zero values. By default this is `True`. Can also be a list of `"leading"`, `"trailing"`, and/or `"internal"`. [max_output_units]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of time units to display. By default (`None`), all possible time units will be displayed. [pattern]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["{x}"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : A formatting pattern that allows for decoration of the formatted value. [use_seps]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to use digit group separators. [sep_mark]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[","]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The string to use as a separator between groups of digits. [force_sign]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Should the positive sign be shown for positive values? [locale]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : An optional locale identifier for formatting values. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A list of formatted values is returned. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#2694c4c1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from great_tables import vals vals.fmt_duration([3661, 86400, 172800], input_units="seconds") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['1h 1m 1s', '1d', '2d'] ``` ::: :::
